messages:
jen: viewers flagging a black screen + captions ~20s behind. leadership audio ok. @video-team any updates? :rotating_light:
mark: seeing encoder flaps on the dashboard, frame drops around 11:03. pulling a quick snippet now.
mark: ```enc-7 WARN keyframe_gap=1.9s
enc-7 ERROR reconnecting to ingest```
priya: can we continue audio-only and put a slide up explaining video issue? also request local capture in case we need to stitch later.
emma: starting local OBS capture -> /tmp/allhands_1755550000.mkv. cmd: `obs-cli --startrecording`
gabe: prepping backup ingest and will coordinate a DNS flip in 10s. notifying stage ops to pull SD cards after.
ops-bot: Incident created IN-2024-522: all-hands video degraded -> paging video-team.
mark: DNS flip in 3...2...1... swapped to backup ingest, monitoring.
mark: backup accepted stream, bitrate recovering. please confirm video on your end. :eyes:
emma: I can see picture back on hosted player, local file growing. checksum queued.
zach: requesting cam1 SD ASAP to recover the ~30s gap near 11:03. stage ops acknowledged.
leo: once SD arrives I'll stitch cam1 + emma local for a short clip. ETA ~12-15m.
priya: follow-up: create a runbook item to enable automatic local-record fallback for all-hands. this would avoid manual start next time.
ops-bot: Action created: TICKET-ALLHANDS-63 "Auto-enable local-record fallback for all-hands" assigned to ops.
jen: posting a short note to participants and putting up "video issues, continuing audio Q&A" slide. will share stitched clip when ready. thanks team. :thumbsup:
